---
title: "Software Setup"
---

## Julia Installation

Install Julia from:

<https://julialang.org/downloads/>

Recommended version:

```bash
julia --version
```

Use Julia 1.10 or newer if possible.

## Development Environment

Recommended options:

1. VS Code with the Julia extension
2. Pluto notebooks
3. Jupyter notebooks via IJulia
4. Julia REPL

## Basic Package Installation

```julia
using Pkg

Pkg.add([
    "Plots",
    "CairoMakie",
    "LinearAlgebra",
    "SparseArrays",
    "Statistics",
    "DifferentialEquations",
    "OrdinaryDiffEq",
    "DataFrames",
    "CSV"
])
```

## FEM Packages

```julia
using Pkg

Pkg.add([
    "Gridap",
    "GridapGmsh",
    "Gmsh"
])
```

## ML and PINN Packages

```julia
using Pkg

Pkg.add([
    "Lux",
    "Flux",
    "Optimization",
    "OptimizationOptimisers",
    "OptimizationOptimJL",
    "ComponentArrays",
    "Zygote",
    "SciMLSensitivity",
    "NeuralPDE",
    "ModelingToolkit"
])
```

## Optional CFD Packages

```julia
using Pkg

Pkg.add([
    "WaterLily",
    "Oceananigans",
    "Trixi",
    "VoronoiFVM",
    "MethodOfLines"
])
```

## Test Installation

```julia
using DifferentialEquations
using Plots

f(u,p,t) = -0.01u
prob = ODEProblem(f, 1.0, (0.0, 10.0))
sol = solve(prob)

plot(sol)
```

If a plot appears, the basic installation works.

## Quarto with Julia

Install Quarto:

<https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/>

To render this website:

```bash
quarto render
```

To preview locally:

```bash
quarto preview
```
